title: 第338章 能不能带师兄一起发财第337章 今日怎么突然如此大方
content_zh:
“改日老夫定要去老祖那里参他一本！”
嘴上骂得厉害，张玄鹤手里的动作却一点不慢，他捏起那枚破境丹仔细检查一遍，确认药力没有问题，立刻小心翼翼地收进袖中。
收好丹药后，他眼珠轻轻一转。
不对劲。
陆青山那只铁公鸡，竟能随手掏出一枚四阶破境丹送人，这搞不好是宗主正值清仓发横财，他抓到这个时机，故意哄骗来的。
既然如此……
就不能让这老家伙轻易离开。
多少得再弄几件过来！
想到这里，张玄鹤抬手吩咐道：“让他进来。”
话刚出口，他又觉得不妥，赶紧站起身。
“算了，老夫亲自去会会他！”
张玄鹤甩开衣袖，快步朝山下赶去。
没过多久，他便满脸带笑地出现在洞府门前，方才那副怒气冲冲的模样早已消失不见，整张老脸笑得满是褶子。
“哎呀，陆师弟！”
“今日到底是什么风，竟把你吹到老夫这里来了？”
“去去去！”
陆青山吹胡子瞪眼，半点好脸色都没给。
“张老鬼，少跟本长老来这套。”
“别以为我不知道你在想什么，你是不是觉得，这枚丹药是我刚从师妹那里哄来的，特意拿到你面前炫耀？”
张玄鹤神色一僵，下意识点了点头，又赶忙把脑袋摇得飞快。

“哪里，哪里！”
“旁人不知道陆师弟的本事，老夫还能不知道吗？”
张玄鹤满脸堆笑，侧身让开道路，“来来来，陆师弟，山上请！”
“咱们师兄弟也许久没坐下来好好喝杯茶了。”
陆青山斜了他一眼，这才背着双手，慢悠悠地朝山上走去。
两人很快来到山顶大殿。
张玄鹤亲自取出灵茶，斟满一杯，推到陆青山面前。
“陆师弟，请。”
“这可是老夫珍藏多年的灵茶，你千万不要客气。”
陆青山看着他那副殷勤模样，哪能不知道他打的什么主意？
“行了，少来这些虚头巴脑的。”
他端起灵茶喝了一口，随即抬手一翻，从储物戒指中取出一只丹瓶。
瓶塞拔开。
哗啦！
一枚枚丹药从瓶中滚落出来，在桌上铺开，每一枚都缠着淡淡灵光，清一色全是四阶丹药。
content_en:
"I will definitely go to my ancestor to read his book someday!"
Although he cursed fiercely, Zhang Xuanhe's movements in his hands were not slow at all. He picked up the Realm Breaking Pill and inspected it carefully to confirm that there was no problem with the medicine's potency, and immediately put it carefully into his sleeve.
After putting away the elixir, he rolled his eyes slightly.
Something is wrong.
Lu Qingshan, that iron rooster, was able to casually take out a fourth-level realm-breaking elixir and give it away. Maybe it was because the sect leader was clearing out his inventory and making a fortune, so he seized this opportunity and deliberately deceived it.
In this case...
We can't let this old guy leave easily.
I need to get a few more!
Thinking of this, Zhang Xuanhe raised his hand and ordered: "Let him come in."
As soon as the words came out, he felt something was inappropriate and quickly stood up.
"Forget it, I will go meet him personally!"
Zhang Xuanhe threw off his sleeves and hurried down the mountain.
Not long after, he appeared in front of the cave door with a smile on his face. The angry look he had just now disappeared, and his whole old face was full of wrinkles.
"Oh, Junior Brother Lu!"
"What kind of wind brought you here today?"
"Go, go, go!"
Lu Qingshan blew his beard and stared, not showing any good looks.
"Old Ghost Zhang, don't do this with me."
"Don't think that I don't know what you are thinking. Do you think that I just coaxed this elixir from my junior sister and showed it off to you?"
Zhang Xuanhe's expression froze, he nodded subconsciously, and then quickly shook his head.
"Where, where!"
"Others don't know what Junior Brother Lu is capable of, how can I not know it?"
With a smile on his face, Zhang Xuanhe stepped aside to get out of the way, "Come on, come on, Junior Brother Lu, please come from the mountain!"
"It may have been a long time since our senior brothers sat down and had a cup of tea."
Lu Qingshan glanced at him sideways, then slowly walked up the mountain with his hands behind his back.
The two quickly arrived at the mountaintop hall.
Zhang Xuanhe personally took out the spiritual tea, filled a cup, and pushed it in front of Lu Qingshan.
"Junior Brother Lu, please."
"This is the spiritual tea that I have treasured for many years. You must not be polite."
Lu Qingshan looked at his attentive look, how could he not know what he had in mind?
"Okay, stop these vain people."
He picked up the spiritual tea and took a sip, then raised his hand and took out an elixir bottle from the storage ring.
Uncork the bottle.
Wow!
Pills rolled out of the bottle and were spread out on the table. Each pill was wrapped with a faint aura, and they were all fourth-level pills.
